items.title: President Xi nevers wastes a good crisis. As Iran, Ukraine and Palestine distract the world, he tightens his grip | Simon Tisdall
items.summary: Ever the strategist, the Chinese leader is taking the offensive, both abroad and at home. Or if the Welsh were told their language and poetry were banned and must no longer be taught in schools.
